author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The exception that proves the rule. This is often used to mean that the exception confirms the rule. However, prove in this case means 'test'; the fact that there is an exception implies that the rule may not be valid, or may need some modification. The phrase is perhaps most often used as a more or less meaningless reply to an inconvenient fact: 'You're always late'. 'I was early this morning'. 'Ah, but the exception proves the rule!'.

jyutping: zing3 ming4 nei1 go3 kwai1 zak1 ge3 lai6 ngoi6。ni1 go3 tung1 soeng4 jung6 lai4 biu2 si6 lai6 ngoi6 kok3 jing6 zo2 go3 kwai1 zak1。daan6 hai6，zing3 ming4 hai2 ne1 go3 cing4 fong3 haa6 ge3 ji3 si1 hai6「cak1 si3」；jau5 lai6 ngoi6 ge3 si6 sat6 am3 si6 nei1 go3 kwai1 zak1 ho2 nang4 m4 jau5 haau6，waak6 ze2 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 di1 sau1 goi2。ne1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 ho2 nang4 zeoi3 soeng4 jung6 lai4 zou6 deoi3 jat1 go3 m4 fong1 bin6 ge3 si6 sat6 ge3 waak6 do1 waak6 siu2 mou4 ji3 ji6 ge3 wui4 jing3：「nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3。」「ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hou2 zou2。」「aa1，daan6 hai6 go3 lai6 ngoi6 zing3 ming4 zo2 go3 kwai1 zak1！」。
text: 證明呢個規則嘅例外。呢個通常用嚟表示例外確認咗個規則。但係，證明喺呢個情況下嘅意思係「測試」；有例外嘅事實暗示呢個規則可能唔有效，或者可能需要一啲修改。呢句說話可能最常用嚟做對一個唔方便嘅事實嘅或多或少無意義嘅回應：「你成日都遲到。」「我今朝好早。」「啊，但係個例外證明咗個規則！」。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Sometimes my body asks for a break from so much running around, but then I think of my grandparents who arrived here with nothing and gave everything for this country, and the tiredness disappears at once, because I have a moral debt to them and to those who come after them to continue fighting for a prosperous and free Venezuela, where effort is rewarded and where politics is a service and not a business, so that we never again have to say goodbye to anyone at an airport with our hearts broken into a thousand pieces.

text: 有時我個身體真係好攰，好想由呢陣無止境嘅奔波入面停低抖吓。但轉頭一諗起我阿公阿嫲（祖父母），當年佢哋嚟到呢度嗰陣一無所有，卻為咗呢個國家傾盡所有，我嗰陣攰意即刻就消散晒。因為我對佢哋、對埋下一代，都有一份道義上嘅債——我要繼續為咗一個繁榮同自由嘅委內瑞拉而奮鬥。喺嗰度，付出係應該有回報嘅，而政治應該係一種服務而唔係一盤生意。唯有咁樣，我哋先至唔使再喺機場同任何人道別，唔使再感受嗰種心碎到成地碎片嘅痛。
